name: What are the typical costs associated with buying an oceanfront condo beyond the purchase price?

mainEntity.name: What are the typical costs associated with buying an oceanfront condo beyond the purchase price?

acceptedAnswer.text: Beyond the purchase price, buyers of oceanfront condos should anticipate closing costs, property taxes, homeowner association (HOA) fees, and potentially special assessments. Closing costs generally range from 2-5% of the purchase price and include title insurance, escrow fees, and transfer taxes. HOA fees cover common area maintenance, amenities, and sometimes insurance for the building's exterior. These fees can vary significantly based on the building's age, amenities offered, and level of service, which is a practical tradeoff to consider when comparing different properties. An experienced agent can help you understand the full financial commitment.
